confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough aggregated estimates from crowdsourced cost-of-living pages and expat price lists. Cappuccino and draft beer are the best-supported. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass are weak: no usable 2026 Arica restaurant prices were found, so cocktail is set at about 2.5x beer and wine at about 1.1x beer. Mid-range two-person meal is uncertain, with sources ranging from about $37 to $54. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX: the 0.6720 observation for 2026-11-18 came from a third-party aggregator (ozfinancehub.com.au) that attributed it to the RBA; I did not open the rba.gov.au table, so verify it against the official F11.1 series before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Northern Chilean port city with prices generally below Santiago and broadly in line with other mid-sized northern Chilean cities such as Iquique and Antofagasta. Food and drink anchors rely on Chile-wide and Santiago-adjacent price references, adjusted down for Arica. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Latin American tourist city.
